resources.string: Time, one bit at a time.
The current time as a binary clock, in your theme colours
A binary clock for your home and lock screen, in your theme colours
Follows your wallpaper and theme colours.
Uses the default teal. Pick any colour below.
Used by the widget, the live wallpaper and the preview above.
Each column is one digit of the time: hours on the left, minutes on the right.
From top to bottom the rows are worth 8, 4, 2 and 1. Add up the lit dots in a column to get its digit.
Place the clock on your home screen. It updates every minute and follows your 12- or 24-hour setting.
Long-press your home screen, tap Widgets, then drag Binary Clock into place.
Set Binary Clock as your live wallpaper to show it on the lock screen. On devices that support lock screen widgets, you can also add the widget there.
Live wallpapers are not supported on this device.
Allow exact alarms so the widget changes right on the minute. Without this, Android may delay updates to save battery.
